fusion_sweep.pre_registered_decision: Because the best result was <= 28/45, retain equal-weight RRF and stop tuning.

documents.unit: one approved knowledge entry equals one chunk

lexical_floor.tokenizer: NFKC + casefold; ASCII alphanumeric tokens with lightweight English stemming; each contiguous Chinese sequence plus overlapping Chinese bigrams; no jieba or word segmenter

reporting.per_plant_use: failure detection only; never model selection or superiority claims

experiment.comparison_caveat: BGE-M3 used no instruction while multilingual-E5-large used query:/passage: prefixes as required by their respective model cards; dev model comparison was therefore protocol-correct but not identical-input.

runtime.similarity: cosine via normalized embeddings and deterministic float64 einsum

notes: Content-only BM25 and dense retrieval use only entry.content and no entity or dimension filters.
Forced Top-K retains zero-score BM25 ties; positive-score-only isolates observed lexical signal.
Every approved knowledge entry is one chunk; no secondary splitting is applied.
Per-plant metrics are diagnostic only because dev plant counts are too small for model comparison.
The lexical-overlap count 4/91 and semantic Top-K pair recall are different metrics and are not placed on one numeric scale.
